# Turn your git log into release notes

> Generate release notes and a CHANGELOG.md entry from git log: grouped by Conventional Commit type, breaking changes first, with a suggested semantic version bump. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/release-notes-generator/)
- [How to write a changelog people read](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/release-notes-generator/how-to-write-a-changelog.html)
